body:
## Pensieve 0.6.6

### Fixed
- The paper radar's reasons ("★ 1.2k on GitHub", "team you follow") now show in Chinese in a Chinese interface.

### New
- **The embodied-AI course in Chinese.** All 25 lessons — every explanation, paper walkthrough, question and research idea — in fluent Chinese written the way researchers write, with the field's English terms kept as people say them. A Chinese interface opens it in Chinese; switch between 中文 and English on any course or lesson page.
- **Translate any course with AI.** When a course has no Chinese (or English) version of something, the page says so, and one click translates it with your AI model (e.g. DeepSeek) — kept on your device.
- **Course files can carry their own translations**, for a course or for your own notes over one.

### Download

| Your system | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | **Pensieve-Setup-0.6.6.exe** |
| Mac with Apple Silicon | **Pensieve-0.6.6-mac-arm64.zip** |
| Mac with Intel | **Pensieve-0.6.6-mac-x64.zip** |
| Linux (64-bit) | **Pensieve-0.6.6-linux-x86_64.AppImage** or **Pensieve-0.6.6-linux-amd64.deb** |
| Android 8+ (HarmonyOS via 卓易通) | **Pensieve-0.6.6-android.apk** |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 15+) | **Pensieve-0.6.6-ios-unsigned.ipa** — install with Sideloadly or AltStore ([how](https://photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app/#ios-install)) |

Already using Pensieve? It updates itself (Settings → General → Updates). Your notes stay as they are.
